parsed.why: Adds tier-1/2 layers atop the parent: in-force criminal drag ban (felony repeat), birth-sex facility and shelter mandate, indecent-exposure statute, birth-sex prison placement, trans-women killing rate above baseline with panic defence intact and no state protections.

Above parent: ranked among most protective divisions, healthcare shield laws enforceable against out-of-state action, court-ordered prisoner care. National passport, entry and custody regime still binds, and one 2024 birth-sex housing sanction plus pending ballot initiatives temper the gain.

Below parent: licence and birth-certificate marker routes closed, governor's sex-by-birth executive order, care ban upheld, assessed among harshest for adults. Mitigating: no in-force law restricting adult restroom use, two cities protect, facility bill died in lower chamber.

Below parent: second-highest risk tier, in-force birth-sex facility law across all schools and colleges, August 2026 licence-marker narrowing, no state nondiscrimination statute. Softened by absent enforcement mechanism, no recorded cases, municipal ordinances and permitted birth-certificate corrections.

Well above parent: public-accommodations ban covering hotels and services, gender-identity hate-crime penalties, panic defence repealed, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, self-ID markers and shield laws. National passport and entry regime remains the limiting factor.
